scope: Oracle annotation segmentation ONLY: every GT cell supplied independently from original source RGB. NOT scanner accuracy, detector accuracy, fair architecture comparison, or deployment evidence.

v13_saved_comparison.matching: Nearest unused selected center <=.45 GT height; approximate matching, not AP.
v13_saved_comparison.limitation: V13 sees resized480x192 whole context and must detect/count/order/reject; v2 receives ideal original RGB1.25square crops. Training data and preprocessing also differ.

v13_word_regression_44.reason: These 44 public negatives are also training/regression inputs.

historical_negative_scope_separate.note: Different input/crop/acceptance contracts; exclude from607 word and2242 cell denominators. Neither establishes physical negative behavior.

limitations: Annotation crops are an oracle unavailable to the camera app.
The frozen607 boundaries are geometric and not human-reviewed lexical ground truth.
V2 used upstream train/validation pages plus Kaggle; word model uses family-separated data. Uploaded/test informed historical v2 promotion.
No physical user camera image was tested; a C/H/J cause on the user phone remains unproven.
Every letter is classified; no dictionary, omission, box tuning, threshold tuning, model selection or fallback integration.
